turn.content: The records settle this clearly. Let me confirm the delivery timing logic: the earlier invoice (FK-2609-0296, 2026-09-12) could only have billed goods received by then — GR-2026-0085A of 2026-09-10. This invoice (2026-09-22) bills the second delivery on the same PO, GR-2026-0085B received 2026-09-21, and the billing position confirms invoicing remains within what was received.
